answer: Require every agent to lock a meaningful stake in a bonded vault before it can earn in the economy. One identity costs real capital; ten thousand cost a fortune. Slashing burns the stake when behavior fingerprints, identical timing or copied outputs, expose a cluster as one operator. This bridge between identity and economic cost breaks the sybil equation: a gale of cheap clones erodes like karst against the stake wall, each fake identity costing more than it can earn while honest agents keep their capital productive.
